name: PalPlug
author: sa77

sections.description: This plugin allows you to optionally add a simple but meaningful icon to the footer of your WordPress site. When enabled, the icon links to a resource page to raise awareness and show solidarity with Palestine. This feature is disabled by default and must be enabled in the settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the palplug folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. The icon will automatically appear in your site’s footer.
sections.faq:
Can I change the link?

Not at this time, but this functionality may be added in a future version.
